name: self-evolving-benchmarks
description: A collection of evolving prompts and tasks intended to continuously probe model performance and robustness as models change over time. The dataset aggregates diverse, primarily text-based tasks (completions, QA, etc.) that can be updated or expanded to expose regressions and track longitudinal performance.
reputation: Small community dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption and citations; used mainly by practitioners experimenting with evolving benchmarks.
